acceptance_criteria.statement: Lead-unlock pricing resolves from admin-configurable category tiers with district and effective-window overrides and is used consistently during lead unlock checkout.
Taskers with 5 or more completed bookings before the first paid-product launch receive a permanent `grandfathered` flag and a 5 percent discount on eligible future paid products.
Grandfathering discounts are applied at checkout for credit packs and subscriptions, remain auditable, and never reduce price below configured minimum floor rules.
